pages.name: Benoni: Fianchetto, 9...a6 10.a4 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted Nd2-f1 with a rook on f1; plan 4 had ...Re8 preparing ...Ne8-d7 and a ...f5 break blocked by the f6-knight; plan 3 rerouted a knight already on d2. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Fianchetto, 9...Nbd7 10.Nd2 a6 11.a4
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted Nd2-f1-e3 with a rook on f1. Rewrote plan 1; overview said "Nd2-a4 system" (reads as a knight move), now "Nd2 and a4 set-up"; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Fianchetto Variation, Hastings Defense, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted the d7-knight via b8-c6; plan 2 had ...f5 breaks blocked by the f6-knight. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Fianchetto, 11...Re8
pages.notes: Overview had Black preparing a ...e5 break with no e-pawn; plan 1 routed a knight f8-e6. Rewrote overview sentence and both plans.

pages.name: Benoni: Fianchetto, 11...Re8 12.a5
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 prepared a ...e5 break with no e-pawn and rerouted a b8-knight already on d7; plan 3 put a knight on b6 covered by Black; plan 4 played ...b6 into axb6. Rewrote all four plans and the overview phrase; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Fianchetto, 11...Re8 12.h3 Rb8
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the f6-knight to e8 with a rook there and pressed an e4-pawn that does not exist; plan 2 pushed e4-e5 from e2. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Fianchetto, 11...Re8 12.h3 Rb8 13.Nc4 Nb6
pages.notes: Plan 4 exchanged the c4-knight with ...Na5 (no knight can reach it); plan 3 was vague; plan 1 relied on f2-f4. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Fianchetto, 11...Re8 12.h3 Rb8 13.Nc4 Ne5
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed e4-e5 with the pawn on e2 and a black knight on e5. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: 6.e4 g6
pages.notes: Plan 3 named Nd2-b3 with no knight on d2; plan 4 rerouted the f6-knight to e8 with the king there. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: 6.e4 g6 7.Bd3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an Nf3-d2-f1 route in a Bd3 line with no knight on f3; plan 4 played ...Re8 before castling and a knight to c5 onto its own pawn. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.
